mechanism: Rifampin is a potent CYP3A4 inducer that dramatically reduces cobicistat plasma concentrations, rendering it ineffective as a pharmacokinetic booster for protease inhibitors.
action: Avoid concurrent use; rifampin is contraindicated with cobicistat-boosted regimens; consider alternative TB treatments such as rifabutin (with dose adjustment) or non-rifamycin-based regimens.
